quests.title: Easybreeze Holiday Resort

dialogue.t: Dear visitors, welcome to Dreambow Drift! Kick back, relax, and take in the stunning views of the canyon from our hot air balloon.
Whenever you're ready, just let me know, and we'll have you aboard in no time!
Please embark from here! We'll set sail soon!
Take your time! Just let me know when you're ready.
Hello, and welcome to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort! I'll get you all checked into your accommodations.
Please take this map, along with a special commemorative photo album we've prepared for our guests.
The resort is made up of four main areas: Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge, Wavey Bay, and Tete Isle. Feel free to explore them at your leisure!

Well, your accommodations are in that direction. Feel free to head there if you need some rest. And, if you're looking to do some shopping, the Easybreeze Market — our busiest attraction — is right over here.

quests.description: Head to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort and enjoy a colorful summer
